description: The Plan Editor must let the author choose which army they are writing a plan for. It used to read the Player 1 army dropdown silently, and since Player 1 defaults to Recon Stomps while Player 2 defaults to Custodes Lions, an author who wanted a Custodes plan pressed the button and got Orks with nothing on screen explaining why — reported by the project owner. This drives the real menu: it asserts the Plan Editor now has its own army picker listing every army, that it still DEFAULTS to the Player 1 choice so nothing changed for anyone who was happy, and then sets it to Custodes Lions while deliberately LEAVING Player 1 on Recon Stomps. That divergence is the whole test: pressing Plan Editor must load Custodes, so the assertion cannot pass by accident off the old code path.

steps.script:
# The picker exists and offers the SAME armies as the seat dropdowns — an
# author must not have fewer choices than a player.
var m = tree.current_scene
if m.plan_editor_army_dropdown == null:
	return "missing"
var n = m.army_options.size()
print("SCENARIO plan_editor_army counts: picker=%d armies=%d player1=%d" % [m.plan_editor_army_dropdown.item_count, n, m.player1_dropdown.item_count])
return "same=%s nonempty=%s" % [str(m.plan_editor_army_dropdown.item_count == n and m.player1_dropdown.item_count == n), str(n > 0)]

# It DEFAULTS to the Player 1 choice, so this change is additive: anyone who
# was already getting the army they wanted still gets it without touching the
# new control.
var m = tree.current_scene
var p1_id = str(m.army_options[m.player1_dropdown.selected].id)
print("SCENARIO plan_editor_army default: picker=%s player1=%s" % [m._plan_editor_army_id(), p1_id])
return "%s|%s" % [m._plan_editor_army_id(), p1_id]

# Now the discriminator. Point the Plan Editor at Custodes Lions and LEAVE
# Player 1 on Recon Stomps. Under the old code the editor read Player 1, so
# it would load Orks and every assertion after this would fail.
var m = tree.current_scene
var custodes_idx = -1
var orks_idx = -1
for i in range(m.army_options.size()):
	if str(m.army_options[i].id) == "custodes_lions":
		custodes_idx = i
	if str(m.army_options[i].id) == "recon_stomps":
		orks_idx = i
if custodes_idx < 0 or orks_idx < 0:
	return "missing custodes=%d orks=%d" % [custodes_idx, orks_idx]
m.player1_dropdown.selected = orks_idx
m.plan_editor_army_dropdown.selected = custodes_idx
var zone_idx = -1
for i in range(m.deployment_options.size()):
	if str(m.deployment_options[i].id) == "hammer_anvil":
		zone_idx = i
m.plan_editor_zone_dropdown.selected = zone_idx
print("SCENARIO plan_editor_army chose: picker=%s player1=%s zone=%s" % [m._plan_editor_army_id(), str(m.army_options[m.player1_dropdown.selected].id), m._plan_editor_zone_id()])
return "%s|%s|%s" % [m._plan_editor_army_id(), str(m.army_options[m.player1_dropdown.selected].id), m._plan_editor_zone_id()]
